name: Hull Item
desc: Something that can be installed in a ship's skill tree or hull upgrade sections.

name: Hull Item (for sale)
desc: Something that can be installed in a ship's skill tree or hull upgrade sections.

name: Refit Schematic
desc: Raises a ship's Hull Upgrade points to the schematic's tier.

name: Master Schematic
desc: Opens one ship's skill tree when Master Schematics are required.

name: Logistics Schematic
desc: Raises one ship's logistics node limit by 1.

name: Deintegration Schematic
desc: Removes one ship's integrations and refunds their story points.

name: Nanite Feedstock
desc: Used to grow nanoswarms at the Crafting Bench.

name: Threat-infused Feedstock
desc: Used for infused crafts on weapon modifiers at the Crafting Bench.

name: Shroud-infused Feedstock
desc: Used for infused crafts on defense, repair and combat readiness modifiers at the Crafting Bench.

name: Phase-infused Feedstock
desc: Used for infused crafts on flux, phase, ship system, mobility, strikecraft and fleet modifiers at the Crafting Bench.

name: Augmentation Nanoswarm
desc: Adds a modifier to an item.

name: Tuning Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the explicit modifiers of an item within their value ranges.

name: Annulment Nanoswarm
desc: Removes a random modifier from an item.

name: Metamorph Nanoswarm
desc: Transforms a unique item into a different unique item.

name: Fundamental Nanoswarm
desc: Rerolls the implicit modifiers of an item within their value ranges.

name: Reshaping Nanoswarm
desc: Replaces a random modifier of an item with a new one.

name: Immutable Nanoswarm
desc: Makes a random modifier immutable on an item. Requires at least two modifiers.

name: Replicator Nanoseed
desc: Creates a mirrored copy of an item.

name: Corrupted Nanoswarm
desc: Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictably.

name: Prefix Inhibitor
desc: Protects an item's prefixes from the next nanoswarm or cipher.

name: Suffix Inhibitor
desc: Protects an item's suffixes from the next nanoswarm or cipher.

name: Star Chart
desc: Coordinates to a star system cut off from hyperspace. Opening a wormhole with it uses it up.

name: Reforging Cipher
desc: Replaces every modifier of a Star Chart with new ones.

name: Erasure Cipher
desc: Removes every modifier from a Star Chart.

name: Cartographer's Cipher
desc: Raises the tier of a Star Chart by one.

name: Wormhole Tech Blueprint
desc: Calibration routines, field geometry and fuel-feed schematics lifted from the Explorarium anchor cache in Limbo. The science teams have spent weeks tracing how the Domain held a wormhole's far end steady, and believe they can build a lattice that does the same for a single set of coordinates. Not a gate. Nothing like one. But it opens.

name: Gateway Array Upgrade
desc: Field readings taken on the far side of a deep chart. The lattice can be retuned to hold coordinates that drift further from known space.

name: Gateway Nexus Upgrade
desc: A full map of how the deepest charts fold. With it, the lattice can hold anything the charts can reach.
